newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE gas oil, fuel oil up on tight prompt supply.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil, fuel oil up on tight prompt supply.

text.p: Tight prompt supply pushed NWE gas oil and fuel oil prices higher on Thursday, but weaker futures led gasoline down, dealers said.

Substantial buying on Wednesday by a number of majors left prompt supplies of heating oil in short supply. Despite a $1 dip in underlying futures, prices were firmer on premium gains. The wide Sept/Oct differential, however, deterred a number of buyers, leaving prompt premiums at IPE Sept +$3 fob ARA, compared with an initial +$4.
"Against the October (IPE) screen, the market is looking very expensive, so it's very quiet," one trader said.
